question: which centre saw the biggest fall in attendance rate from 2023 to 2024

```sql
WITH attendance_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    Centre,
    Month,
    Enrolled_Kids AS Enrolled,
    Avg_Daily_Present AS Present,
    (
      Avg_Daily_Present * 1.0 / Enrolled
    ) AS Attendance_Rate
  FROM attendance_2023
), attendance_2024 AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name AS Centre,
    month AS Month,
    enrolment AS Enrolled,
    average_attendance AS Present,
    (
      average_attendance * 1.0 / enrolment
    ) AS Attendance_Rate
  FROM attendance_2024
), combined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(a23.Centre, a24.Centre) AS Centre,
    a23.Month,
    a23.Attendance_Rate AS Attendance_Rate_2023,
    a24.Attendance_Rate AS Attendance_Rate_2024
  FROM attendance_2023 AS a23
  FULL OUTER JOIN attendance_2024 AS a24
    ON a23.Centre = a24.Centre
    AND a23.Month = a24.Month
)
SELECT
  Centre
FROM combined
WHERE
  Attendance_Rate_2023 IS NOT NULL
  AND Attendance_Rate_2024 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  Attendance_Rate_2023 - Attendance_Rate_2024 DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
